questions.q: Which port does PX4 expect a companion on by default?
questions.explain: TELEM1 is for the GCS, TELEM2 for the companion.

questions.q: Which parameters enable MAVLink for a companion on TELEM2?
questions.explain: Onboard mode is the message set for an on-board computer.

questions.q: Can one port carry both MAVLink and uXRCE-DDS?
The recommended TELEM2 baud rate for a companion?
questions.explain: SER_TEL2_BAUD = 921600 for a short wire and heavy traffic.

questions.q: What should happen when the companion fails?
options: PX4 reboots on a watchdog timer
questions.explain: The boundary of responsibility: the FC flies on its own.

questions.q: Why add the Jetson user to the dialout group?
options: For access to CUDA and the GPU
questions.explain: Otherwise a regular user cannot open the serial port.

questions.q: How do you reliably find which /dev/ttyTHS* is pins 8/10 on your JetPack version?
options: Take the name from any article
questions.explain: The name depends on the board and JetPack (ttyTHS0 or ttyTHS1); only the right port echoes through the jumper.

questions.q: Can MAVLink and uXRCE-DDS share one TELEM2?
questions.explain: MAV_1_CONFIG and UXRCE_DDS_CFG on different ports.
